So p_up sits at 48 on a 4.0 scale, giving -0.16. The findings sum to -0.25 because a weak Q2 rebound offsets a set of small, mostly public negatives.

The bar is thin, so every size is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is a rough read of H1 sales against a pro-rata half of the 27,000m plan (about 11.5-12bn against 13.5bn), not a sourced estimate.

findings.finding: The Q1 決算短信 says ZUIKO Shanghai books sales on shipment and its shipments are concentrated in Q2. Its Q1 sales fell 2,108m yen (-95%) and its OP fell 331m yen year on year. On the balance sheet, work in progress rose 1,900m yen and contract liabilities rose 833m yen in Q1. So standalone Q2 sales and OP should jump sharply from Q1's -225m yen operating loss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 was sold on the China decline: -1.84% on 2026-06-26 and -2.31% the next session (Yahoo chart), and the press read it as a demand problem ('中国向け衛生用品製造機械の大幅減収'), not timing. At last year's analogous H1 (2025-10-03: H1 OP 386m yen recovered, plan held) the stock rose +3.44% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The rebound is guided, so most of it should be priced, and it is sized near 0. The residual: the market sold Q1 on 'China demand collapse' (kabutan/MINKABU headline, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6279&b=n202606260277), and the stock is still below its pre-Q1 level at the 10:05 spot (925 then, 943 now). If the timing story were fully believed, the June drawdown would have fully reversed.
findings.independence: The balance-sheet build (WIP +1.9bn, contract liabilities +0.83bn) is in the same document. Fisco's summary repeats the company's timing explanation (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6279&b=n202606300634): same source, counted once.

findings.finding: The company has cut its full-year OP plan by 60-88% in each of the last three years. FY2024/2 was cut from 2,800 to 1,100 on 2023-09-29, three days before the H1 print. FY2025/2 was cut from 1,680 to 200 in December 2024, and actual came in at -300. FY2026/2 was cut from 1,000 to 240 in February 2026, and actual came in at 162. The FY2027/2 plan of 1,780 now needs about 2,000m yen over the remaining three quarters after a -225 Q1, and the Q1 短信 says cost overruns on delayed new-product projects are continuing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints: 2023-10-03 -8.62% (the plan cut had been pre-released 09-29); 2024-10-04 -6.37% then +10.25% (noise); 2025-10-06 +3.44% (plan held). The FY2026 cut on 2026-02-19 came out after the close, and the next session moved +0.10% (Yahoo chart).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock trades at PBR 0.69 and about 19x a plan EPS the company has missed three years running, which is what a discounted plan looks like. Kabutan's disclosure list through 2026-10-01 shows no 業績予想の修正 filed before this print, unlike 2023, so whether the plan is cut with this release is open. But the last two cuts came at Q3 and Q4, not at H1.
findings.independence: FY2026/2 cut: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260219/140120260219564982.pdf. FY2024/2 cut: https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20231002/140120230929561083.pdf. Q1 cost-overrun wording: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260625/140120260624577830.pdf. Three separate company documents, one pattern.

findings.finding: The company cut its dividend at the H1 print in both of the last two years. At the 2024-10-03 H1 it set the interim at 5 yen against 10 yen the prior year. At the 2025-10-03 H1 it cut the interim from a planned 8 yen to 6, giving priority to growth investment. This year's planned H1 dividend is 12 yen including a 4-yen 80th-anniversary payment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-06: +3.44% despite the interim cut, because a recovered H1 dominated. 2024-10-04: -6.37%, then +10.25% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the dividend is cut is decided in today's 16:00 batch. A cut to a commemorative payment would be unusual, and the FY presentation reaffirms 20 yen with a payout target around 35% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260403/140120260402597796.pdf). So the probability is low and the sign of the reaction is unclear on history. Sized near 0.

findings.finding: The April 2026 FY results presentation states that the FY2027/2 plan does NOT include the cost increase from the Iran situation ('イラン情勢のコストアップ影響は不確定要素として折り込まず'). That is a named, unbudgeted margin risk to a plan that already needs gross margin to recover to 19.2% from 15.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of this line.
findings.why_not_priced: It sat in a public presentation for six months, and the Q1 短信 did not mention it. This is macro-to-company transmission with no company statement since, so it is sized small. It matters only if management cites it in a revision today.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Baseline estimated reaction history (median 4.23%) used as the name's reaction scale
rejected_candidates.detail: Real release dates from irbank/kabutan put several estimated dates on the wrong session (e.g. Q1 FY2027 was 06-25, not 07-02). Real next-session reactions on the last 8 releases: -6.37, -8.94 (2025-04-07, a market-wide crash day), -2.34, +3.44, +0.5, +0.1, +2.83, -1.84. H1 prints: -8.62, -6.37, +3.44. The scale was re-derived from these, not the estimated series.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, the same way as the small priced lean (-0.20) and the margin overhang, so they mostly agree with positioning and add little. The strongest positive the release could carry, which I looked for: a sharp Q2 rebound plus a held plan plus the 12-yen interim paid as planned. That is exactly last year's H1 setup, which rose +3.44%. It is why p_up is 48 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a public series or a computable progress rate goes toward 50 unless the release adds a cut): plan-cut-record finding shrunk from -0.6 to -0.4, the H1 dividend-cut history from -0.2 to -0.15, the Iran cost line from -0.2 to -0.1. All three rest on public documents, and a cut at this print is not signalled.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives, so look for the strongest positive): last year's analogous H1 (plan held, H1 rebound, +3.44%) raised the guided-rebound finding from +0.3 to +0.4 and p_up from 46 to 48.
